name: Expenses help
description: Help mode entries for Molly's Expenses module (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Expenses ledger
entries.text: Your Expense Tracker ledger inside Molly: spent, income and net, then the newest entries. Search narrows the list. It reads the same ledger as expenses.amberxai.com.

entries.title: Add an entry
entries.text: Adds one entry to the ledger. Amount is in dollars; income counts toward income instead of spent.
